attributes.board_name: Virginia Board of Medicine (Advisory Board of Occupational Therapy)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Organized programs, classroom or similar education related to the licensee's OT roles, approved or provided by VOTA, AOTA, NBCOT, a government agency, a regionally accredited college/university, a CMS-deemed accredited health care organization, or AMA Category 1 CME. Up to 2 hours from uncompensated OT services to low-income patients via a health department or free clinic (1 h per 3 h); up to 2 hours from student supervision (1 h per 8 h).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt for the first biennial renewal after initial licensure in Virginia.
rules.audit_note: Attest at renewal (18VAC85-80-70); keep supporting documentation 6 years. Extensions up to 1 year on written request before the renewal date; exemptions for disability, military service, declared disasters.
rules.notes: The current rule requires 10 contact hours per biennial renewal (earlier versions required 20 hours plus a competency assessment form). OTs and OTAs renew biennially during the birth month in each even-numbered year (18VAC85-80-70).
